title: 법률구조법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text: Article 4 (Registration of Changes) Where a corporation registered with the Minister of Justice under Article 3 of the Legal Aid Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") changes any matter specified in the subparagraphs of Article 2 (1) or its articles of incorporation, it shall apply to the Minister of Justice for registration of the change within 14 days from the date of the change. Where registration of a change to the articles of incorporation is requested, documents certifying the change shall be attached. <Amended on Mar. 11, 2019>
